headline: Stonecradle Flares, Godcrofts Churn Returns as Major Fronts Grind On
war_summary: Fishermans Row, storm centre of our last edition, has fallen silent — no flag stirred there in the final three hours, and its nine works still fly Colonial colours. The churn has moved to Godcrofts, where fifty-six flag events mark the day and the latest was logged minutes before this edition closed, though all nine works there remain Colonial; the Dead Lands stays quiet. Stonecradle is the freshest field: fourteen events, most about World's End, the last timed as we went to press, with 4,180 Colonial and 5,870 Warden down and the map split five Colonial to four Warden. Stlican Shelf's Fort Hoarfrost still changes hands, though the Shelf leans seven works Warden to two Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains the costliest front at nearly 23,000 fallen in the day, its five-to-four Colonial line intact as Frostmarch and Crow's Nest trade flags. Callahan's Passage, second in blood at better than 18,000, still burns hard though the hourly toll has eased, and Mooring County has flared anew about The Wind Hills with some 9,000 fallen. Our tally reads 297 Colonial works to 139 Warden, the lone ruin of the prior edition rebuilt. Day 251; no victor declared.
